name: Trollge Universe Incident
desc:
Player Commands 🗨️:
- ;trade Username (this will show a trade request that you have to accept)
- ;trolls Username
- ;items Username
- ;low (makes your hp low for phases, however it requires VIP Gamepass)
Item Commands 🗨️:
- ;openall (open all chest's)
- ;useall (use every consumable item)
- ;zero (removes all oils and bloods in backpack)
